about: Stage 1 city greybox. x/y in every 'map', 'pts', 'x', 'floors' field are pixels of the 7600 px reading version of the master map (y downward). Every 'y'/'yc'/'ry' depth value is in Blender units and is level-C design. 'ev' is the evidence level of the element's X/Z placement: A direct observation, B cross-image inference, C 3D completion.
